name: t100-new-route-survival
description: When a U.S. certificated carrier starts scheduled passenger nonstop service on a domestic city market pair it has not served in the previous 12 months, will that service still be operating in the anniversary quarter 12-14 months later?
split_description: Frozen chronological boundaries by entry month, set before any modelling: train = entries in 2011-01..2014-06; eval (validation) = 2015-10..2016-09; holdout = 2018-01..2018-12. Two 15-month embargo gaps drop all entries in 2014-07..2015-09 and 2016-10..2017-12 so that no split's 14-month label window overlaps the next split's decision period. No entries after 2018-12 are used at all, because their anniversary windows fall inside the COVID-19 schedule collapse and would change the label's meaning. Data pulls cover 2010-01..2020-02 only.
